short_description: A winter storm shuts an airline hub and the legacy auto-rebooker strands the passengers who need help most. The IROPS Copilot (Databricks App on Lakebase) re-accommodates every cancelled flight in priority order — unaccompanied minors, wheelchairs, long-haul connections, urgent messages read by AI Functions, a UC detractor-risk model — inside cost guardrails, cites EU261 / DOT / UMNR policy from a Genie agent, drafts personalised notifications, and commits the rebookings after Duty Manager approval, written back to Delta for the ops dashboard and Genie.
